node_identity_preimage: domain || proposition_id || occurrence_id || source_id || context_id || source_ordinal || epistemic_kind || flags
ordering: node records by node-id followed by dependence edges by child-id then parent-id
root_rule: a node with no parents is its own root; dependent paths retain direct edges and collapse to unique terminal roots
cycle_rule: reject the complete batch and return the exact closed offending node path
